template.name: Color XMUV Time
template.entry_long: roc(ema((close > open) * (high + close) / {p0} + (close < open) * (low + close) / {p1} + (close == open) * close,{p0}),{p1}) > 0 and bars_since(roc(ema((close > open) * (high + close) / 2 + (close < open) * (low + close) / 2 + (close == open) * close,{p2}),1) <= 0) <= 2
template.exit_long: roc(ema((close > open) * (high + close) / 2 + (close < open) * (low + close) / 2 + (close == open) * close,10),1) < 0
template.notes: The documented composite bar price is rebuilt with boolean weights ((H+C)/2 on bullish bars, (L+C)/2 on bearish, close on doji) and its smoothed slope gives the colour; bars_since<=2 with a positive slope marks the bullish flip bar. Smoothing length 10 is a fallback, and the session filter plus point-based stops are unavailable.
